## Roaming Pets 1.0.0

Give your tamed pets a little more freedom! Sneak + right-click an owned, tamed pet to toggle between roaming and following you. Set the roaming distance with `/roaming <radius>`; use `/roaming 0` for unlimited roaming. Roaming state is saved with each pet.

### Requirements
- Minecraft 26.3
- Java 25 or newer
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer
- Fabric API 0.162.0+26.3

In multiplayer, install the mod on the server. Clients do not need it to connect.
